title: wksplit multi-language backend + round-trip gate howto
desc: Concrete per-language backend selection and the round-trip verification gate for wksplit-smart-multi-language-dedup-round-trip-spec.
steps: MULTI-LANGUAGE BACKENDS by file extension: ps1/psm1 -> PowerShell AST FunctionDefinitionAst.Extent, verify with [Parser]::ParseFile == 0 errors. cs -> partial-class split, verify with Roslyn or dotnet build. py -> python ast module (FunctionDef/ClassDef by lineno/end_lineno), verify with python -m py_compile. sh/bash -> function-block split, verify with bash -n. js/ts -> JS AST (acorn/babel or tsc), verify with node --check or tsc --noEmit. UNKNOWN/generic -> marker-based block split + hash dedup.

ROUND-TRIP GATE (mandatory before ANY write): (a) output PARSES/COMPILES clean; (b) SYMBOL-SET IDENTITY -- function/class name set in output equals input's unique set, diff empty; (c) for dedup, canonical copy = last-definition-wins for interpreted languages. Never overwrite the original until the gate passes.
ENCODING SAFETY: read/write BOM-free UTF-8 consistently. Preserve non-ASCII byte-exact; verify round-trip hash of unchanged regions.
SAFETY PROTOCOL: timestamped backup (file.bak-ts), operate on a sandbox copy, run the round-trip gate, swap into live path only on full pass.

requirements.expect: prints dup ratio + dedup map without reading content into LLM
round-trip parse + symbol-set diff empty before swap
